lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Glass Slippers. Full contact.
The Glass Slippers unfolded.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Pierce.
The light streaming from the Glass Slippers converges at a single point.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Stop.
The light subsides.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Excellent.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: I was concerned your output might be enough to break through the energy barrier,

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: but your control and precision are impeccable.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Not bad.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Your control as a Nikke is flawless. Better than I expected, even.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: As one would expect from a Grimms model.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: For someone who has spent so long wandering the surface, you've kept your weapon in remarkably good condition.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: I heard another Heretic had once taken it from you, so I thought I'd have a look.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: I found a small section of shattered glass at the tip and had it repaired. You shouldn't have any trouble with it now.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Once you shore up your mental fortitude, I daresay you'll be able to land a solid blow on the Queen.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Now then, I have an assignment for you...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Wait.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why are you doing this for me?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I never agreed to your deal.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Does it truly matter?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It does. Depending on who's offering it, kindness without an ulterior motive only makes me uneasy.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Because I wished to.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Consider it one of a witch's many intellectual pursuits.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: I have no intention of taking advantage of you, so enough with the nonsense and pay attention.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: I have a little assignment for you.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Assignment?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Look into those red eyes of yours in the mirror,

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: and remind yourself that your body is no different from a Rapture's.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What...? How could you say that...!

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: What matters is that even as you do so, you must never deny that you are Cinderella.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Only then will you be able to remain yourself, even after you've transformed.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I don't enlarge myself.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: No, you must.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: The time will come when you have no choice but to.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: And when it does, you'll choose that path.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: There will come a time when you realize that's what it takes to defeat the Rapture Queen.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: If you choose to transform by any means necessary,

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: you must have an unwavering sense of who you are

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: if you're to remain in control after being exposed to corruption.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Otherwise, you'll be taken over.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: What do you think defines you?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Look at the reflection in that weapon. What do you see?
Cinderella gazes at her reflection in the Glass Slippers.
She sees herself staring back with red eyes.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Those red eyes prove that you're still a Rapture... a Heretic.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: But does acknowledging that truly make you any less yourself?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'll give it some more thought.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Very well.
*Knock, knock*

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Who could be knocking so unnecessarily politely?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Come in.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: E-excuse me...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Mori?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: C-Cinderella?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I-I'm sorry. I can come back later if you're busy...

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: We're finished here. Come in.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: What is it you want?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Oh, um, well... I wanted to ask you something.
Mori glances over at Cinderella.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: S-sorry, Cinderella.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: There's something I really need to ask her as her slave...!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Enjoy your conversation.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Th-thank you.
Cinderella steps outside.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: what was it you wanted to ask me badly enough to lie to your friend and send her away?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I-I wasn't really lying.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'm here because there's something I wanted to ask you as your slave.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: As my slave?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: She told me you wouldn't turn me away if I came to you as your slave...

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Tsk, I see the hellions couldn't keep their mouths shut.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: G-Gretel didn't do anything wrong! She just saw how worried I was, so—

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Enough defending yourself. Speak.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: I owe you, after all. I was going to grant you a wish anyway.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Owe... me?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: It's nothing you need concern yourself with.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Wait, is this about the vase?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: ... You knew?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: That night, after I got back from learning how to do the chores, I kept thinking about it...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: No matter how much I thought about it, I just couldn't remember touching the vase.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: And then, thinking back on it,

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: the timing of the vase breaking and the timing of you coming in all angry... It was almost too perfect.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I don't know how you did it,

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: but I started to wonder if you'd broken the vase on purpose and blamed me for it because you wanted us to stay here.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I figured it was probably because of Hansel and Gretel...

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Because of those hellions?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You can call them your slaves or hellions, but it's pretty obvious you care about them.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I can tell just by the looks on Hansel and Gretel's faces and the way they talk to you.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: So I thought maybe you did it to give them some time to make up with my friends.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Am I wrong?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Well, I won't deny that.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: And yet, knowing all this, you still chose to remain my slave?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I... I'd like my friends to make up with Hansel and Gretel, too.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Haha!

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: I took you for nothing more than a timid little duckling,

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: but it seems you're quite the clever one.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: L-little duckling...?!

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: So, my perceptive little slave,

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: what is it you wish to ask?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Um, w-well...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: D-do you know how I could get stronger quickly?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Gretel told me that Miss Ber, you—

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Miss Ber?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: S-sorry! I-I didn't mean to say that...!

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: You all seem rather fond of calling me whatever you please.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Never mind. Continue.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: W-well... I heard that you know a lot about Nikkes...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: So I was wondering if you might know a way for me to get stronger quickly.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I just... I don't want to hold everyone back, no matter what...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: It was the same when we fought another Heretic before,

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: and when we were exploring the coast this time. I couldn't help at all...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Someone had to stay behind just to protect me.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I think... the same thing's probably going to happen again in the great battle ahead.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: I thought as much.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Frankly, you're... too weak to set foot on the surface.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: You may have no desire to hold them back, but unfortunately, you will.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Having someone weak on the battlefield can be just as fatal a liability as having a wounded soldier.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: And against what you're about to face, that risk will be all the greater.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: She is not an opponent you can afford to underestimate. No, she is one you must never let your guard down against.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I knew it...

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: A way to grow stronger quickly, you say...

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Why, there is one.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: R-really?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Though it may cost you your sanity.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Wait, what?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: What I mean is, it's impossible by any ordinary means.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Unless you're willing to turn your entire body into a Rapture, that is.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I-is that the only way...?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: It is.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: You think there's a way to gain power without paying a price?

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Do you truly believe this world would be so kind?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: There's no such thing.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Find something you can do, even if you lack the strength to fight.

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: Do you really think taking up a gun and fighting on the battlefield

lines.speaker: bernoullia
lines.text: is the only way you can be of use to those girls?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Got it.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'll... think about it.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Something I can do even if I'm not strong, something I don't need a gun for...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What could that be...? Maybe something like housework?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What am I saying? I was actually proud of myself just for getting better at housework...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: This really isn't the time to be proud of something like that...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: H-Hansel...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: You've gotten better at housework.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: So you should be proud of yourself.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... You must've worked hard to get this far.
Mori stares at Hansel, dumbfounded.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Why... are you staring at me like that?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Ha, haha!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Wh-why are you laughing?!

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Did I say something weird?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: No, it's just...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: It really hit me that you and Gretel are twins.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I just thought it was funny that you both said the exact same thing.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel said... the same thing I did?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Yeah, she said the same thing earli—
*Creak*
Grave walks out of the house.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Hide...!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: H-huh?!
Hansel pulls Mori behind the wall with her and hides.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Why are we hiding?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I don't want to see Abe yet...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I don't know what face I'm supposed to make when I do.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Hansel...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Then maybe I could go and—
Hansel suddenly grabs onto Mori.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Are you really gonna leave me here all by myself?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: N-no! I was just going to take her somewhere else...
Mori sneaks a glance toward Grave from behind the wall.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Isn't that... Gretel?
Hansel looks in the direction Mori is pointing.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel?

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Abe.
Gretel approaches Grave.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: You're...

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: I'd like to talk to you, Abe...

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: I mean, Grave. Can I?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: ... Of course.
